trophies.guide: There is no separate task here: this trophy pops on its own the moment the other 54 are all earned, so treat it as a finish line rather than a job. When you are down to the last few, work through this guide's checklist top to bottom and look for the stragglers; in practice the final one is usually the 100% completion gold, A Long Road, or one of the long grinds such as the stunt and challenge totals. Nothing about it can be missed, and it needs no online play at all.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks simply by playing through the start of the game, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss. Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission and the trophy pops when it ends. It is one of the first missions of Chapter 1, and every story trophy in this guide works the same way: finish the mission and move on.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a few seconds late. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole list that cannot wait: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, and make a manual save at the start of the chapter so you have a way back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end and this unlocks automatically; it cannot be missed. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: switching between Jason and Lucia becomes available after the Breakfast Run mission, Moses hands you the Scooter Bros app, and the Daily Driver mission unlocks the real-estate app for buying garages. Use the chapter to start the slow grinds early by scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app and studying animals with binoculars whenever you meet a new species.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and this pops on its own. While you are in this chapter, pick up the tools that later trophies need: Yasmani's jewelry jobs hand you the Snap Gun used for Sneakthief, the shooting ranges and Top Fun drone races open up, and Yago's street-racing strand appears. One caution from the guides: Yago's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass, so save first and race it the moment it appears rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and this unlocks with the chapter. Near the end of this chapter an optional mission, That's Where The Money Is, opens up the bank vaults, which matter for Maximum Withdrawal and for the 100% checklist, so take that mission when it appears instead of rushing to the chapter's end. The chapter also holds several mission trophies of its own, all of which pop by finishing their missions.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy pops. It cannot be missed, but because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, keep a manual save from just before the final mission in one of the 15 save slots before you start it, so you can go back if you want to replay the ending. After the credits the game lets you keep roaming Leonida freely, and everything outside the story stays available for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run and this pops; like every mission trophy it cannot be missed. It is worth noting for planning: switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, and from then on you can call the other one in as your partner, which the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist and this unlocks automatically. It is a story trophy, so there is no side requirement and no way to miss it; just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play and this pops. It is unmissable story progress, so no preparation is needed; finish the mission and carry on with the chapter.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners and this pops. It is unmissable story progress; finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown and this unlocks. It is a story trophy and cannot be missed. The same airport, VCIA, is where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can happens later, so you will be back here on your own terms after the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory and this pops. It is unmissable story progress in the final stretch of the game, so just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This gold is the longest job on the list and the hardest trophy in the game by the guides' reckoning. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist; work you did earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. You do not need to find everything: the checklist asks for selected portions, such as 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, all 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's target decks, 30 of 40 races won and 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals. Clear the robbery rows first, since they also pay for the garages and gear the other trophies want.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total, and the game tracks them in the progress stats. The trophy needs 250, but 100% completion wants 300 of the 397, so keep going past the pop instead of stopping. The cheapest way to build the total is to chain jumps and flights during normal travel rather than grinding one spot, and to start early so the count grows while you play the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: the activities are the sports and pastimes scattered around Leonida, such as racing, fishing, the arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, bowling, the shooting ranges and the drone races. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so work through the list casually and the trophy pops when the ninth type registers. If one will not register, check that you actually started the activity rather than just walking up to it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges, spread across the ranges around Leonida. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so this silver and the gold A Long Road share the same grind. Take each challenge one weapon at a time, learn its target pattern before chasing the gold time or score, and come back with a better weapon or more practice rather than burning attempts on a range that is not clicking. There is no shortcut: every challenge needs its gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations around Leonida; one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist goes further and wants all 42 races, plus all 42 drone time trials, so keep racing a location after its trophy win if you are chasing A Long Road. Learn each course's corners before pushing for speed, and retry a location immediately while the route is fresh in your mind.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer; winning the same race twice does not count, so the game is tracking variety, not volume. Mix race types as you go and tick off new ones rather than replaying a favourite. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 won, so this bronze pops on the way to the bigger target.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, so watch for the message rather than hunting for him. Head to the marked spot, take the challenge, and out-fish him; if you lose, you can try the challenge again, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four in-game arcade games, and any of them counts, so pick the one you are best at and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score or a win against another player; finishing the game is the trigger.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. The character strands stay open after the story ends, so there is no rush and nothing to miss; take the missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the end of the line. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver, which only takes certain other strands.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. The strand stays available after the story, so finish it during cleanup whenever it suits you. Kenton is also tied to the treasure sets on the 100% checklist, so his strand is worth doing while you are collecting.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and the strand stays open after the story, so it is a cleanup job, not a timed one. Like Andy's strand, Billy's does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Not every strand counts, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward it, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not, because those characters have their own trophies or other roles. One warning: Yago's Chapter 3 race, Race Against Yago, is time-sensitive and marked with an hourglass, so save first and do it as soon as it appears. There are more strands than the eight needed, so a missed one does not block the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. The strand stays open after the story, so take it during cleanup; the trophy pops when the last mission ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. It stays available after the story, so there is no deadline; finish the strand during cleanup. Tyrone's strand does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver, which needs other strangers.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the one potentially missable trophy in the game, so read it carefully. The first spot is offered in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation, and complete that meditation before leaving Chapter 1, because it is gone once the chapter ends. Whether the trophy strictly needs that first spot is not confirmed, but the guides agree you should do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot is reported to count for both characters if you meditate there together, so bring your partner every time. Note that 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy needs three more than the checklist does.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting questline starts after Chapter 2 and is Jason-only, sending you after animals through target decks; the exact animal for this trophy is not yet confirmed by the guides, so follow Bret's quests as they come and the trophy should pop when the unique hunt is done. One tip the guides agree on: a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunting quests reward.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are scattered around Leonida, so pick up every set you pass while exploring rather than hunting one set at a time; three finished sets pop the trophy, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting well past this silver if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations around Leonida. Any mix counts: landmarks (31 of them), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags all feed the same total. The habit that saves hours is to scan everything unfamiliar the moment you see it, vehicles and landmarks alike, while you are travelling for other reasons, instead of sweeping the map at the end; the 100% checklist needs the same 100 scans, so this silver pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges listed under Progress, then Challenges. Most of them complete on their own while you play the story, rob, race and explore, so check the list after the story and mop up the easy ones first. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so do not stop at 50 if you are chasing the platinum; leave the ten hardest or most time-consuming challenges for last, or skip them if they are not needed.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The easiest pairing is a bank vault job: vaults always bring four stars, and escaping one with your partner also works toward Maximum Withdrawal, so the two trophies can pop together. Note the timing: the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until you are fully clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner with you, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Call your partner first, then hit three shops back to back while the police are still chasing you; if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks and you have to start over. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app, which counts as discovering them. Scan traffic as you drive from the start of the game and the total grows without a dedicated grind. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past this bronze; rare models are the ones that take the extra time, not the first hundred.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Fill your Focus first, pick a group of enemies such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so you can drop five before the effect ends. Adrenaline extends Focus, which helps if the fifth target is slow to fall.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and take off with it. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway, take off and fly about one kilometre away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops once you are clear. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire at enemies until the trophy pops; the description's joke about Rhinos is the clue, since a Rhino is the tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without triggering detection. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies, so do that strand first. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it; kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and if someone spots you, reload rather than pushing on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape, out of the eight in the game. Vaults open up through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner, and have a fast bike ready, because a vault job brings a four-star wanted level straight away. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so this silver pops on the way to the full set.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and get away clean; a bank vault job also counts toward this one if you escape from it. As with the other robbery trophies, the pop comes once you are clear of the police, not the moment you grab the cash.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and clear the fog from the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in, landing to clear the spots the plane misses. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery, so do your exploring while you scan landmarks and traffic.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. One per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this bronze pops early on the way to the full set. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts around the map; rob one, escape, and move on to a gang you have not hit yet.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger for this one is still unconfirmed by every guide checked for this entry, so treat the description literally: find a bar with a view over Ocean Beach, order a cocktail there, and see if it pops. If it does not, check the guides again later; players are still pinning down the last few hidden trophies, and this guide will not invent a step it cannot source.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed, but the description points to driving out through the showroom window, in the style of the classic showroom escape, so take a car inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass. If that does not pop it, the method is still being worked out by players, and this entry will not present a guess as a fact.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt and Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn. Bring sticky bombs, then take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a sticky bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable; go back and finish the set.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you; the beach gym is a good spot. Work out regularly as a pair rather than grinding one character alone, because the trophy needs both of them at maximum.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the count, so it fills up on its own while you play the rest of the list; there is no separate grind to plan. One warning from the guides: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile on purpose, because that profile is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, but the exact trigger for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed by every guide checked for this entry. No reliable method is published yet, so this entry will not invent one; play normally, retry things you fail, and check the guides again once players have pinned it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description, What the hell just happened, points at witnessing something strange, but the exact trigger for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed by every guide checked for this entry. It is most likely tied to one of the game's odd world events, so explore widely and pay attention to strange encounters; until players pin it down, this entry will not present a guess as a method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: strike a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by the guides, so treat this as the working reading of the description rather than a proven recipe; try it from a slow-moving car with a melee weapon equipped, and check back once the method is pinned down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank jobs and payday loan jobs, and you fence them by selling them to your contacts; Yasmani pays the most, so favour him when you have the choice. The total is cumulative across the whole game, and the same $250,000 also counts toward the 100% checklist, so this bronze pops while you are working the robbery rows.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. Every kind of shop counts, so just buy what you need as you play: weapons, clothes, car parts and the rest all feed the same total. It pops on its own during a normal playthrough, and sooner if you are buying garages and gear for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garages for sale, through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, so save up during the story and buy them as you can afford them. The four garages the story gives you do not count; only the eight you buy do.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. The app comes from the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars you do not mind keeping.
trophies.name: On the Spot
